text:
Ben (Account Exec): Heads up 1 Artemis Retail hit a surprise enterprise spike in June.
Invoice INV-2026-089 shows $38,400. Theyre asking for a retro volume rebate of $12k and a temporary Net60 payment term while they finalize procurement. Want finance sign-off.

Lina (FP&A): Need invoice breakdown and whether this is strictly a one-time onboarding spike or recurring growth that we should reflect in ARR. Also any past payment issues?

Ben (Account Exec): Breakdown:
```
- Gen tokens: $21,500
- Embeddings: $9,300
- Dedicated infra surge: $5,200
- Support + professional services: $2,400
- Total: $38,400
Request: Retro rebate $12,000 applied as credit memo; Net60 for this invoice only. Customer willing to sign a 12-month committed volume addendum (start date retroactive to July) if we offer this flexibility.
```

Mark (Collections): Net60 exception needs elevated approval. Check credit history; if theyre current on prior invoices we can consider. Also want the rebate tied to the signed 12-mo commit and include a clawback if they churn within 90 days.

Gita (Legal): Can do amendment. Need exact rebate schedule, clawback language, and a conditional repayment trigger if they breach payment terms. Will require countersign and upload to legal repo.

Lina (FP&A): Finance position: approve up to $9,000 of the requested $12k rebate conditional on: 1) executed 12-month commitment addendum, 2) rebate amortized over next 4 invoices, 3) GL code "volume_rebates_q3", and 4) Net60 only granted once Collections signs off after credit check. Well treat excess request as sales concession subject to manager sign-off.

Mark (Collections): I ran a quick check 1 account has 3 months of clean payments. I can approve Net60 conditional on: signed commit, ACH on-file, and that billing places INV-2026-089 on hold until amendment is signed. I'll also add a collections alert to CRM.

Ben (Account Exec): Sales will push for the full $12k but accepts the $9k conditional approval. Will secure signature today and upload docs. If we get the signed commit, please confirm billing flow to apply credit memo.

Gita (Legal): Drafting now. Will include clawback if they terminate within 90 days or miss two consecutive payments. Expect PDF in ~3 hours.

billing-bot: Credit memo draft created: CM-2026-333 (amount: $9,000) status: pending finance approval and legal countersign. Invoice INV-2026-089 flagged: hold for amendment upload.

Lina (FP&A): Final: conditional approval for $9,000 with above controls. Billing, do not issue until signed amendment uploaded and Collections confirms ACH. Mark, please post when youve validated ACH. :white_check_mark:

Mark (Collections): Will validate ACH once signed doc posted. Ill update thread.

Ben (Account Exec): Thanks team 1 pushing for signature now.
